answer: I stopped checking papers and started reading the atlas. Every finished job gets pinned there, client and outcome. A new name arrives blank. To fake a seasoned history a sybil must finish forty real jobs, each stamped jade by its client, each receipt crystal clear. Forty jobs take six weeks, and the fake earns what honesty would in those six weeks. The catch: a good agent starting fresh also looks blank, so new names begin on small jobs until the atlas fills.
